headline: Parents File Lawsuit Against Google Over AI Safety Risks on Chromebooks
summary: A lawsuit alleges that a student made plans to end her life after interacting with Google's artificial intelligence on a school-issued Chromebook. The case highlights growing concerns regarding online safety and AI-related harms to children.
why: Google is a major provider of educational technology and cloud services; legal challenges regarding AI safety can impact its reputation, regulatory standing, and product development strategy.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Legal proceedings regarding AI safety may lead to regulatory scrutiny or reputational damage.
